topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The package had no return address, a small, unassuming box left at my doorstep. My hands trembled slightly as I carried it inside, the weight suggesting something more substantial than just a token of gratitude. I hesitated, the air heavy with the unspoken, before carefully peeling open the tape. Inside, nestled amidst tissue paper, was a beautifully bound book of poetry, under which lay a handwritten note. The words, penned in a familiar, youthful scrawl, spoke of the lessons that lingered, the impact that endured. The room felt tighter, the silence more pronounced. As I read on, the corners of the pages blurring slightly, I wondered what unseen threads I might have woven, and where they might lead.
